mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cut_plan_revision WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND cutover_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND source_plan_revision_id = #{query.sourcePlanRevisionId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY revision_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM cut_plan_revision WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND cutover_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY revision_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision_no), 0) FROM cut_plan_revision WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND cutover_task_id = #{query.taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cut_plan_revision SET edit_mode_code = #{query.editModeCode}, content_snapshot = CASE WHEN #{query.contentSnapshot} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{query.contentSnapshot} AS JSON) END, file_artifact_id = #{query.fileArtifactId}, file_version_no = #{query.fileVersionNo}, file_reference_key = #{query.fileReferenceKey}, file_fact_version = CASE WHEN #{query.fileFactVersion} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{query.fileFactVersion} AS JSON) END, file_scope_version = #{query.fileScopeVersion}, file_sha256 = #{query.fileSha256}, ownership_confirmed = #{query.ownershipConfirmed}, version = #{query.newVersion}, updater = #{query.updater}, update_time = #{query.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.planRevisionId} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND current_marker = 1 AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE cut_plan_revision SET status_code = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_by = #{query.submittedBy}, submitted_at = #{query.submittedAt}, approval_instance_id = #{query.approvalInstanceId}, approval_version = #{query.approvalVersion}, version = #{query.newVersion}, updater = #{query.submittedBy}, update_time = #{query.submittedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.planRevisionId} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND current_marker = 1 AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE cut_plan_revision SET status_code = 'INVALIDATED', current_marker = NULL, approval_version = #{query.newApprovalVersion}, invalidated_by = #{query.invalidatedBy}, invalidated_at = #{query.invalidatedAt}, invalidation_reason_code = #{query.reasonCode}, version = #{query.newVersion}, updater = #{query.invalidatedBy}, update_time = #{query.invalidatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.planRevisionId} AND status_code = 'SUBMITTED' AND current_marker = 1 AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND approval_version = #{query.expectedApprovalVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
